license_note: The zai-org/GLM-5 repository contains no license file; its model-card frontmatter declares MIT and the rendered page shows that declaration, matching the reviewed GLM-4.5 posture. The companion code repository is separately Apache-2.0 and governs code, not weights. The Z.ai API is governed separately by the platform terms.

license_evidence.scope: zai-org/GLM-5 model weights, tokenizer, and chat template as declared by the pinned model-card frontmatter; no repository license file

access_boundary: This record represents the zai-org/GLM-5 BF16 instruction release. The GLM-5-FP8 repository, GLM-5.1, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3 and their variants, the Turbo records, the GLM-4.x family, the Z.ai API and chat products, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Developer-published BF16 Safetensors checkpoint with tokenizer and chat template plus documented vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers, Transformers, and xLLM serving paths
First-party Z.ai API documentation names glm-5 as a served model, and Novita AI documents a third-party serverless path for the release
tradeoffs: The MIT declaration lives only in card frontmatter metadata with no license file and no grant prose in the card body
Neither the model card nor the API documentation states a versioning policy or deprecation posture
